reviewer: CodeWise2 coordinator, independent of frontend author
rationale: Validates arbitrary proposed parent relationships, including disconnected cycles, multiple roots, out-of-range parents and overfull nodes; distinct from traversing a guaranteed tree or partitioning an arbitrary undirected graph.771 non-visible directed structural fingerprints remain after node labels and sibling order are erased, a conservative lower bound.
algorithmReview: Exactly one root, legal nonself parent indexes, child capacity at most two, and traversal reaching every node jointly establish a rooted binary tree. Independent per-node ancestor chains test cycle/root reachability without the breadth-first implementation. Invalid proposals are valid question inputs and must return false.
coverageLimits: Native execution remains an independent runner gate; no learner code executed by this review.
Curriculum decisions inspect actual taught skills and immediate links; final whole-bank actual-engine history audit remains separately required.
